Static analyzer that flags the classic .NET "sync over async" footgun: a direct '.Result' property access, '.Wait()'/'.Wait(timeout)' method call, or a '.GetAwaiter().GetResult()' chain, on an expression whose static type is Task/Task<T> -- instead of 'await'ing it. Blocking on async code this way can deadlock under a captured SynchronizationContext (classic ASP.NET, WPF/WinForms) and causes thread-pool starvation under load even where it doesn't deadlock (ASP.NET Core).
